result.summary: The page is mostly visually consistent, but the bottom navigation is broken by unsafe bottom-area positioning. Horizontal carousel items are also clipped at the right edge, though this may be intentional.

issues.description: The system gesture/home indicator overlaps the bottom navigation, crossing through the search and saved icons. The navigation icons are also partially cut off by the bottom edge.
issues.suggestion: Apply the device bottom safe-area inset and increase the navigation bar’s bottom padding so all controls sit fully above the system gesture area.

issues.description: Content in the horizontal category and restaurant carousels is abruptly clipped at the right edge, including a partial category pill and truncated restaurant card/title.
issues.suggestion: If the partial-item treatment is intentional, add consistent trailing spacing to clarify horizontal scrolling; otherwise constrain item widths so complete items fit within the viewport.
